requirements.requirement: The system must render a dedicated prescription behavior React component when structured prescription data is present in the message payload.
The system must display prescribing patterns within the component using the transformed data produced by EVAL-P-RX-UX-S2.
The system must display condition-to-prescription mappings as human-readable labels within the component.
The system must display the prescription behavior contribution to the overall provider quality score within the component.
The system must integrate the prescription behavior component into the MessageBubble rendering pipeline without breaking existing message types.
The system must render the prescription behavior component in the correct position within the message flow based on structured content ordering rules.
The system must apply consistent styling with existing provider quality scorecard components.
The system must support reuse of the prescription behavior component across multiple messages without duplicating logic.
The system must gracefully fallback to standard markdown rendering when prescription behavior structured data is absent.
The system must display a partial UI with available fields when prescription behavior data is incomplete rather than failing to render.
The system must not throw runtime errors when encountering malformed prescription behavior data in the message payload.
The system must conditionally render the prescription behavior component only when the message type indicates a provider quality scorecard context.
The system must ensure the component is responsive and renders correctly across supported viewport sizes.
The system must preserve accessibility attributes including semantic HTML and screen reader compatibility within the component.
